0022600224.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9) are 15th in the West and on an eight-game losing streak, sitting 7 games back in the Northwest with a 1-4 home record, while the Orlando Magic (2-7) are 12th in the East, on a four-game losing streak, and 3.5 games back in the Southeast with a 0-4 home record. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), Keyonte George (ankle sprain), and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain), and Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), and Tristan da Silva (calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, though the Jazz lost 0-2 to the Magic in 2025-26, including a 120-117 loss in Orlando on February 7, 2026.
